title: arngz's Finished toast can show a window title, through an unmovable entry's reason
body:
arngz's Finished toast shows the first failure's words as they are: the finished point's `first` (ST589246c's progress.md), drawn by opt/arngz/lib/toast.lua. A failure's reason can quote the window's title. An unmovable entry's does: it fails (REPORT_ONLY, opt/arngz/lib/arngz.lua:1306) with a reason that quotes its title (opt/arngz/lib/plan.lua:700). So the toast can put a window title on screen.

That breaks the toast's rule (ST589246c/eae7633d's body, and toast.lua:110-113): a toast names an app and never a window title, because a title can carry a mail subject or a file name, and a toast is on screen for anyone looking, a screen share included.

Found by ic in its second read of STca1b7f9's design, item 5 (~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/stca1b7f9/design-read-r1.md, sha256 25826ce6), 23 Nov 2026. Item 1.5 of the same read sets this rule for STca1b7f9's new full-screen refusal.

The fix, by vc's ruling of 23 Nov 2026, rides STca1b7f9's change and its one booked run. The toast shows no window title: no failure's words that can reach `first` quote one, and the run log can keep the title where it helps. The reason's text is plan.lua's, so the change is cc's. Its test is an AT in that run, and the commit that lands it closes this issue.
